QUOTE: "`MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` defaults off... by default, nothing inside the library runs concurrently and no mutex is taken... None of these are in `library/`. The library itself spawns nothing."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library spawns no threads by default, but it never says the pthread example compiles to a stub main under that condition, and it lists the pthread server as a thread-spawning site.
